name: Taming the Beast
label: Quest
description: Taming the Beast: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Every adventurer begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras.
Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.
Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well tamed, friend! You are becoming adept already.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
